full_name: V.V. Ganeshananthan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Fiction & Poetry Bunting Fellow University of Miami
bio: V.V. Ganeshananthan, a fiction writer and journalist, is the author of Love Marriage: A Novel (Random House, 2008), set in Sri Lanka and its diasporas. She most recently taught in the Helen Zell Writers’ Program at the University of Michigan. Following her time at the Radcliffe Institute, she will join the faculty of the University of Minnesota.
